payout_quote: Instawork's own press releases (via GlobeNewswire): Instawork Pros experience 'Get paid quickly: ability to get paid the same day' and 'Financial stability: view shift earnings before they work.' Third-party reports: weekly Friday pay at first, with Instapay (next-day/same-day) unlockable after early shifts.
timing: Same-day pay ability via Instapay (official company claim); base pay weekly on Fridays per worker reports.
eligibility: Profile with work history, references, and a short quiz
steps: Download Instawork and build your Pro profile (history, references, quiz)
Get approved and browse local hospitality/warehouse/retail shifts
Book shifts — earnings shown before you work
Complete the shift and get rated on a 5-star scale
Get paid: weekly Fridays by default, or unlock Instapay for same-day access
catches: Same-day pay isn't day one — worker reports say Instapay unlocks after your first couple of shifts
Ratings directly control which shifts you're offered; one bad review hurts
1099 contractor: no workers' comp, no benefits
Tips on some gigs can lag weeks behind the hourly pay
biggest_catch: The 'get paid the same day' headline has a ramp: you typically start on weekly Friday pay and only unlock Instapay after proving yourself over early shifts — so your first week is NOT same-day money.
notes: Official company press releases claim same-day pay ability and pre-shift earnings visibility. Range $120-$200 per 8h shift at typical $15-$25/hr. Speed 'today' reflects the official same-day claim; caveats documented.

weasel_words.quote: 'Ability to get paid the same day' — ability, not default; base cadence is weekly until Instapay unlocks.

repeatable.cadence: Build your profile, book a shift, complete it, get paid weekly on Fridays — then unlock Instapay for same-day access and repeat the loop daily.

maximize: Finish your profile, references, and quiz TODAY — approval speed is the whole game; take any first shift regardless of location to unlock Instapay faster; then chase high-volume hospitality venues (stadiums, hotels) for steady shifts; keep a 5-star streak since ratings decide your shift feed; refer other workers for reward bonuses once you're in.
who_pays: Instawork pays you for each completed shift — weekly on Fridays by default, with same-day access via Instapay once you've unlocked it. The businesses you work for pay through the platform.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older, build a Pro profile with work history and references, and pass a short quiz. Hospitality, warehouse, and retail shifts expect an appropriate presentation, and you need the Instawork app on your smartphone.
work_available: Shifts are metro-dependent and your 5-star rating controls which ones you're offered — one bad review can shrink your feed. New workers start on weekly Friday pay and only unlock same-day Instapay after their first couple of shifts.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid for completed shifts, with earnings shown before you work. You're rated on a 5-star scale after each shift and ratings directly control your shift feed. Instawork's specific non-payment triggers and removal policy are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Joining is officially free for workers. The real cost is time: building your profile, gathering references, and passing the quiz — plus the first-week ramp on weekly pay before Instapay unlocks. Unpaid time: commuting between gigs and waiting on shifts in thin markets. Note: you're a 1099 contractor, so no workers' comp or benefits.
when_cash_arrives: Weekly on Fridays by default; same-day pay via Instapay unlocks after your first couple of shifts — so your first week is not same-day money. (Tips on some gigs can lag weeks behind hourly pay.)
